title: Scraper Console Execute Permission Consistency

items.action: run scraper tests and open or download scraper outputs

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.execute permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing scraper run and download authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; console mutation/output actions are aligned with existing execute authorization.

audit.reason: Existing scraper execution behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Read-only console history remains readable; only run and output actions require execute.

notes: AdapterRunLogConsole previously exposed run and output open/download actions to users with read-only scraper access. Backend run and download dependencies both require fair_crm.scraper.execute; these UI actions now hide and fail closed without execute permission.
